talents.description: Your allegiance. He gains wool from being hit, and gains it faster the worse the day is going. Free -- but you may swear to only one path's engine at a time, and respeccing is the only way to change your mind.
Attacks ignore a quarter of what the target is hiding behind.
Every hit takes a piece of their guard with it, for the rest of the fight, and it stacks. Soften the wall and the whole squad walks through it.
Unlocks Provoke: one enemy can see nothing but you on its next turn.
A goaded enemy swings wide. They hit you a fifth softer.
Provoke takes the whole room, and every enemy fixed on you feeds the fleece. The engine comes fully online at about the moment the transform does.
A quarter more damage into anything already on its way down.
A kill throws half your weight into whoever was standing next to it.
A kill does not cost you the turn. Once per turn -- he is heavy, not infinite.

The three roots gather. Unlocks the transform: 7 wool for three turns of splash, weight and speed, plus temporary health that leaves again when it does. Free, but it wants 9 embers spent in this path first.
Four turns of it instead of three.
Every kill buys another turn of it, up to three.
Below a third health the timer simply stops running. Played right, the transform is no longer a timer at all.
A quarter more armour once you are under half.
Under a quarter health, nothing lands for more than a quarter of your maximum. No single blow ends it.
Once a fight, the hit that would put him down leaves him standing on 1.
Unlocks Headbutt: a swing that also knocks the target a place down the order.
The shove does not delay what they were winding up. It takes it.
Becoming the ram drives the entire enemy line back a place.
Below a quarter health the transformation stops being a button. Free, gated at 20 embers spent in this path.

Your allegiance. Wool comes from wards being struck, not from being struck yourself -- you cover somebody, they take the hit, you get paid. Free, and you may swear to only one path's engine at a time.
Unlocks Ward (2 wool): the next blow to land on you is 40% softer.
Warding stops costing the turn. She can cover herself AND do something with the day.
A ward also knits: 3% of the wearer's health back, each turn, for two.
Six percent a turn, for three.
A ward breaking heals whoever was wearing it for a tenth of their health. Losing one stops being a loss.
Every ward you are carrying makes you hit harder: a quarter more per warded ally, and double if the ward is on you.
Half again per ally, and two and a half times on yourself.
Triple on yourself -- and it does not vanish the instant the ward does. One turn of grace to make the loss count for something.
The three strands gather. Unlocks Wail: 10 wool -- the whole meter -- and nothing in the room hits for more than half for two turns. Free, but it wants 9 embers spent in this path first.
A ward also covers one other, at half strength.
Everyone, at full strength, for the same two wool.
Unlocks Gift: Mana (2 wool) -- a quarter of an ally's mana, back.
Unlocks Gift: Fury (3 wool) -- an ally's next swing lands half again as hard.
Unlocks Gift: Haste (5 wool) -- an ally goes next, whatever the queue thought.
Unlocks Shatter (3 wool): break every ward you have out. Each one throws your full weight at something.
Breaking your OWN ward hits three times as hard and leaves the target open -- and leaves you with nothing between you and the room.
Wards stop breaking. They last the fight. Free, gated at 20 embers spent in this path.
